'''Sarkese''' was the native language of the [[Sarkan/Legends|Sarkan]] species from [[Sarka/Legends|Sarka]]. It was a complex language that used subtle body gestures as well as sounds<ref name="The New Essential Guide to Alien Species" />

Most Sarkans, specially diplomats and scouts, were fluent in both Sarkese and [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]], although they were only literate in their own language.
